# ADR-3020: A02: SHA1 integrity checksum for artifact lane 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

SHA-1 collisions undermine integrity guarantees.

## Decision

Release pipelines MUST NOT rely on a SHA1 integrity checksum for artifact lane 8 (A02-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Prefer SHA-256 or stronger digests.
